response.sql: WITH per_source AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS funding_source, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / s.boxx) AS avg_y_vs_x_diff, SUM(s.aream2) / SUM(s.volm3) AS area_to_volume FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux), overall AS (SELECT AVG(area_to_volume) AS avg_av FROM per_source WHERE area_to_volume IS NOT NULL) SELECT ps.funding_source, ps.avg_y_vs_x_diff, ps.area_to_volume, ps.area_to_volume - o.avg_av AS above_average_by FROM per_source ps CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ps.area_to_volume > o.avg_av ORDER BY ps.funding_source

assumptions.assumption: The area-to-volume figure is SUM(aream2) / SUM(volm3) per funding source. Each sum skips NULLs on its own, so a record with only one of the two values still counts toward that sum.
The average Y-vs-X difference uses only records where boxx and boxy are both non-NULL and boxx is non-zero. A zero boxx gives NULL in SQLite, and AVG skips it.
Projects with a NULL funding source are left out. Spatial records that match no project are dropped by the inner join. Funding sources with no usable ratio are excluded from the cross-source average.
The cross-source average is the unweighted mean of the per-source area-to-volume figures, and 'above average' means strictly greater than it.

alternatives.interpretation: Compute the area and volume totals only over records where both aream2 and volm3 are non-NULL, so the two sums cover the same records.
alternatives.sql: WITH per_source AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS funding_source, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / s.boxx) AS avg_y_vs_x_diff, SUM(CASE WHEN s.volm3 IS NOT NULL THEN s.aream2 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN s.aream2 IS NOT NULL THEN s.volm3 END) AS area_to_volume FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux), overall AS (SELECT AVG(area_to_volume) AS avg_av FROM per_source WHERE area_to_volume IS NOT NULL) SELECT ps.funding_source, ps.avg_y_vs_x_diff, ps.area_to_volume, ps.area_to_volume - o.avg_av AS above_average_by FROM per_source ps CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ps.area_to_volume > o.avg_av ORDER BY ps.funding_source
